demo_banner: Demo mode: data is saved on this device only. Connect Supabase to go live.
need_login: Sign in to use this tool.
no_tokens: Not enough tokens. Upgrade your plan or wait for the monthly refill.
dash_sub: Pick a tool to get started.
st_hint: Upload any image to turn it into clean line work.
gen_placeholder: Describe the tattoo: subject, style, placement…
gen_refused: The generator only creates tattoo designs. Describe a tattoo and try again.
gen_not_configured: The generator is not connected yet. Add a Gemini API key to enable it.
col_hint: Pick a color and tap any area inside the lines to fill it. Use the brush or gradient for finer control.
cl_inks: Inks and needles used, with batch numbers
cl_publish_ok: Client agrees to have photos published
cl_private: Client files are private. Only you can see them.
pc_note: An estimate based on your own prices. One session is up to 5 hours.
sup_verify: Check shipping to Uzbekistan and customs fees before you order.
email_sent: Check your inbox for the sign-in link.
auth_not_configured: Sign-in is not connected yet. Add your Supabase keys to enable it. You can still try the studio in demo mode.
try_demo: Open the studio in demo mode
reported: Thank you. The post was sent for review.
post_blocked: Posts must be about tattoos and use respectful language.
post_need_plan: Posting is available on Pro and Pro Gold.
checkout_soon: Payment happens on a secure Lemon Squeezy page: Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal. We never see or store card details.
contact_saved: Thank you. We'll be in touch soon.
lock_sub: Glow preview, client files, inventory, pricing and suppliers open with Pro and Pro Gold. Client files stay private to you.
col_grad_hint: Drag inside an area from where the first color starts to where the second ends. 0% softness gives a hard split halfway; higher values blend smoothly.
col_brush_hint: Paint freely. With "Stay inside the area" on, color never leaves the area where you started.
pc_tiers: Price by the longest side of the design
pc_tiers_hint: Edit these to match your prices. Sizes in between are scaled smoothly. Changing currency converts approximately, so check them.
pc_hourly_on: Charge by the hour instead of size
pc_hourly_hint: Optional. Pricing stays by size unless you switch this on and enter an hourly rate.
pc_manual: Final price (type your own if you like)
set_profile_sub: Shown to others in the community and artist search, except your phone.
set_name_hint: The name people see on your work and posts: your name or your studio.
set_username_hint: A unique name for your page. Lowercase letters and numbers only.
set_username_taken: That username is taken. Try another.
set_city_hint: So clients find you when they search for an artist in their city.
set_phone_hint: For contacting you. Never shown publicly.
set_language_sub: Language of the site and studio. Change it here or at the top of the page.
set_account_sub: Sign in to manage your account.
set_email_hint: We will send a confirmation link to the new address.
set_email_sent: Confirmation link sent to the new address.
gst_fineline: Very thin, soft lines with fine detail, often small.
gst_blackwork: Solid black areas and strong contrast.
gst_traditional: Classic American style: bold outlines and simple, clear designs.
gst_neotrad: Like traditional, with more detail and shading.
gst_realism: Photo-like drawing with shading and gradients.
gst_irezumi: Japanese style: dragons, waves and koi.
gst_dotwork: Shading built from tiny dots instead of lines.
gst_minimal: Very simple: a small symbol with as few lines as possible.
gst_script: Words and lettering in a beautiful hand.
gst_sigil: Sharp, thorny flowing lines, a trending modern style.
gst_ornamental: Repeating ornaments and detail, like mandalas.
gen_style_hint: Not sure about styles? Pick the closest to what your client wants.
col_glow_hint: You are painting with glow ink: color only the parts you want to glow, in the colors you choose.
col_glow_page: Choose exactly which parts of the design glow under UV light and in which color, then compare normal and UV light.
pay_ok: Payment received. Your plan updates within a minute.
pay_off: Online payment isn't connected yet. Contact us and we'll activate your plan manually.
pay_fail: Couldn't open checkout. Please try again.
pay_cancel_note: Cancel any time — access stays until the end of the paid period.
col_load_error: This file couldn’t be opened. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image (iPhone HEIC photos: export as JPG first).
cl_hint: Tap a shape in the tattoo to fill it, or paint with the brush. Color only lands on the tattoo, never on the background. Left: normal light. Right: under a UV lamp. Pinch, or click the picture and use the mouse wheel, to zoom.
